_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): audit trail — AuditLog model + log_action helper + admin-only paginated /admin/audit endpoint. Self-contained (its own admin guard), no cross-feature imports.
name: feature-audit-log
description: Audit trail: AuditLog model, log_action helper, admin-only paginated GET /admin/audit (filter by actor/resource/action).

variables.name: resource
variables.description: Default resource label used in the model comment (any string, cosmetic)

notes: After applying: 1) app.include_router(router), 2) make sure the AuditLog model is imported so SQLAlchemy creates the table, 3) call log_action(db, claims, 'create', 'user', item.id, ...) inside mutation endpoints (the claims dict comes from get_current_user). The guard checks claims['role'] == 'admin' (feature-auth tokens carry the role claim). Frontend: admin table via comp-crud-page at {base_path}/admin/audit.
